pains.label: RTO is killing us: COD orders get refused, returned or are fake
pains.definition: Cash-on-delivery orders that buyers refuse, that come back as RTO (return to origin), or that were fake. The brand pays shipping both ways and its cash is locked.

pains.label: Can't control cash on delivery on Shopify
pains.definition: Merchants struggle to set up and control COD on Shopify: limiting it by place, order value or country, COD apps breaking, cancelling COD orders, getting the COD money.

pains.label: Need order confirmations and updates sent on WhatsApp
pains.definition: Merchants can't easily send order confirmations, COD checks and shipping updates on WhatsApp, or confirmations don't reach customers, so they hunt for apps and API setups.

pains.label: Our ad account got disabled and appeals go nowhere
pains.definition: Meta (Facebook) or Google disables or suspends the ad account, often without a clear reason. Appeals are ignored and ads stop.

pains.label: Ads cost more and return less
pains.definition: Ad costs and customer acquisition cost keep rising while return on ad spend falls. More budget brings worse results or junk orders.

pains.label: Ad clicks and purchases don't show up
pains.definition: Ad platforms and the store disagree: clicks, add-to-carts and purchases are not tracked or attributed, so the brand can't judge its ad spend.

pains.label: Amazon suspended or deactivated our seller account
pains.definition: Amazon suspends or deactivates the seller account (related accounts, account health, policy points). Appeals get rejected for months while payments and stock are stuck.

pains.label: Our shipping partner lets us down: late pickups, weight disputes, no support
pains.definition: Courier aggregators such as Shiprocket delay pickups, raise weight disputes, are unreliable and give poor support. Sellers call it fraud.

pains.label: Shipping and COD charges are high and confusing
pains.definition: Merchants can't tell what shipping, label and COD charges will be, and look for a cheaper courier.

pains.label: We lose chargebacks to scammers
pains.definition: Fraudulent orders and chargebacks: merchants lose disputes even with good service and feel the platform sides with scammers.

pains.label: Support load grows faster than the team
pains.definition: As orders grow, support tickets and WhatsApp chats pile up. Helpdesks charge per ticket and cheap AI bots frustrate customers.

pains.label: Agencies charge a lot and many don't deliver
pains.definition: Brands can't tell which marketing agency to trust or what it should cost. Many feel agencies are scams that don't deliver.

pains.label: Marketplace and quick-commerce fees eat our margin
pains.definition: Amazon, Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart fees, commissions and surcharges cut the brand's margin.

pains.label: WhatsApp messaging costs keep going up
pains.definition: Per-message WhatsApp API fees, Meta rate hikes and provider markups make WhatsApp costs rise and hard to predict.

pains.label: Our search traffic dropped (AI answers take the clicks)
pains.definition: Organic sessions fall: Google's AI Overviews and ChatGPT answer the question, rankings bring fewer visitors, and the brand is not cited in AI answers.

pains.label: Revenue grows but profit doesn't come
pains.definition: D2C unit economics don't work: brands scale sales but stay loss-making, and some shut down after over-expanding.

pains.label: Cash is stuck in stock, ads and payouts
pains.definition: Working capital runs short: money is locked in inventory, ad spend and delayed payouts, so brands look for loans or revenue-based financing.

pains.label: New e-commerce rules to comply with (labels, GST)
pains.definition: New or changing rules (Legal Metrology labelling and country of origin, consumer protection e-commerce rules, GST and TCS for sellers) force changes to listings and filings.

pains.label: Our emails land in spam and open rates keep dropping
pains.definition: Marketing and order emails sent through Shopify Email, Klaviyo and similar tools go to spam or junk. Open rates fall below normal and campaigns can get stopped. The brand can't find the cause or fix it.

pains.label: App and tool bills keep climbing, even after we cancel
pains.definition: Shopify apps and tools such as Klaviyo cost more than expected. Apps keep charging after they are uninstalled, email tools bill by active profiles and raise prices, and the billing rules are hard to follow. WhatsApp message fees belong to whatsapp-costs-rising.
